thesis: The deepest storage build in the set on the thinnest secured revenue: no capacity market, a tender floor whose level is unpublished, and a merchant spread at a record low as the fleet neared 8,000 MW. At build cost the reference project only just clears the platform's yields, on modelled CIS floor-and-ceiling terms no award publishes, and falls short of the fund's target. Four hours, on a tender award or a toll.
储能建设规模居各市场之首，锁定收入却最薄：没有容量市场，招标保底水平不公开，且随着储能规模接近8,000MW，市场化价差跌至历史低点。按建设成本测算，参考项目仅勉强达到本平台收益率要求，且依赖于平台建模、任何中标合同均未公开的CIS上下限条款，达不到基金目标回报。四小时，依托招标中标合同或租赁。
